description:
UNIT THREE is an independent team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, driven by curiosity, innovation, and a passion for space exploration. We aim to transform real-world challenges into meaningful solutions by leveraging technology, creativity, scientific thinking, and data-driven approaches.

Our vision is to explore new possibilities, think beyond boundaries, and contribute innovative ideas that create a positive impact on Earth and beyond.

Explore. Innovate. Impact.
summary:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive storytelling website that brings attention to NASA's abandoned but historically significant equipment on the Moon and Mars. We developed an immersive web experience featuring four historic missions and their machines: the Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle and Surveyor 3 on the Moon, and the Sojourner and Opportunity rovers on Mars.
Through cinematic visuals, interactive exploration, real NASA imagery, and easy-to-understand storytelling, our website allows visitors to discover the history, achievements, and lasting legacy of these machines. It transforms forgotten pieces of space exploration into engaging stories that connect people with humanity's journey beyond Earth.

Our project addresses the challenge by highlighting the scientific and historical importance of equipment left behind on other worlds. It reminds us that even when a mission ends, its contributions remain. By making these stories accessible and engaging, we aim to inspire curiosity about space exploration and preserve the legacy of the machines that helped us explore the unknown.
details: We have built a basic space exploratory website targetting school age space enthusiasists. It allows users to navigate to moon and mars and discover about the discarded NASA missions. It acts like a storytelling that can be easily understood by school students. It has a feature of 3-D model viewer. The highlight of our project is it has a quiz feature with feedback where students can take up quizzes to assess their knowledge about the mission. The impact of our project is to bring more curiosity and a great experience through our website which paves the way to explore more. Our project is primarily built using java Script with AI assistance. This a pure frontend website and doesn't contain any backend application. The frontend is built using REACT+VITE. However, our project is not developed to industry standards but we have implemented the core idea of our project. We didn't focus much on being more creative instead we focused on how our project can be different from already existing one.
